We have applied three templates sequentially:

Step 1 (template 324324) gave fragments: A = Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1 and B = Nc1ccccc1N.

Step 2 (template 1914396) applied to A gave fragments: C = Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1 and D = O=C(O)CC(=O)O (some diacid? Actually O=C(O)CC(=O)O is succinic acid). Good.

Step 3 (template 733) to C will give two fragments: need to apply apply_template to get results.

Let's apply template 733 to C.
